chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washa and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, all from Dawud ibn Sirhan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the gold with which children are ornamented, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, my father (peace be upon him) used to ornament his children and his women with gold and silver, so there is no problem with it.'

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: So there is no problem with it / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for children to wear gold jewelry in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* clarifies the specific ruling for children, distinguishing it from the general prohibition of gold for men in other traditions. By citing the precedent of Imam al-Baqir (AS) adorning his own offspring and wives, the Imam establishes a clear exception for boys, reinforcing the scholarly consensus that the restriction applies primarily to adult males rather than all males indiscriminately.
